SMTO-UI-0002 — Invalid server response

GUID: 501c36bd-e395-470b-9b3e-6614071f6273
Slug: ui-response-invalid
Domain: UI · Subsystem: ui

What happened

  • The SMTO server sent a reply this page couldn't read. This often happens right after an update, when the page and the server are different versions. If you were saving something, it may already have been saved.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Copy any text you haven't sent, then reload the page. Reloading loads the version of the page that matches the server.
  2. Check whether your action already happened: open the task or item and look for your change before doing it again. The server may have finished it even though its reply couldn't be read.
  3. If this keeps happening, ask your administrator to check Settings › Setup › Server updates and finish any update or restart it shows. A half-finished update can leave the page and the server out of step.

What success looks like

  • The page shows current information without this message.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't copy SMTO data from a different version over this installation to fix it; use the normal server update.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The browser received a response it could not interpret.

What this means

  • JSON parsing or response validation rejects the payload shape, expected identities, cursor records or required collections. This presentation or validation result does not establish an external task outcome. Use the saved run, resource revision and receipts when deciding whether an action can safely be repeated.

Why this can happen

  • JSON parsing or response validation rejects the payload shape, expected identities, cursor records or required collections.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare response shape and request identity with the installed client contract.

How to fix it

  • Response parsing or validation rejected the body (not JSON, such as a proxy or HTML error page, or missing expected fields, identities or collections); the response status is in Technical details. Reload to get current UI assets and confirm the page and Server versions match; if a write was in flight, re-read state before resubmitting, and upgrade through Settings › Setup › Server updates rather than overwriting state with an incompatible version.
  • Refresh current state and inspect service/build compatibility; preserve the occurrence if the invalid response repeats.

Retry and execution caution

  • Apply the correction and confirm the relevant state before requesting another attempt. Prior completed work remains governed by its receipts.

How to verify the fix

  • A fresh state read returns valid data for the same request and compatible client.

What not to do

  • Do not overwrite the original state with an incompatible version; use the supported upgrade path.

Technical notes

  • This presentation or validation result does not establish an external task outcome. Use the saved run, resource revision and receipts when deciding whether an action can safely be repeated.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
